simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בַּעֲלִיס (H1185) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: בַּעֲלִיס (Baʻălîyç) means Baalis , an Ammonitish king First listed occurrence: Jer 40 14.

definitions.full: H1185. Baalis בַּעֲלִיס proper name, masculine (Gr Monatsschrift, 1885, 471 reads בַּעְלִיס ; = בֶּןעֲֿלִיס son of delight ? compare below בְּ ) king of Ammonites Jer 40:14 (Manuscripts & Jos Ant. x. 9 , 2 read בעלים ). בְּעֹן see מען בעל בית below בית .
definitions.rootNote: probably from a derivative of 5965 with prepositional prefix; in exultation;
